description: Fork of exp144 (E=64, qk_tph=384, 392M, final 1.7101 — current E=64 SOTA). Two changes: (1) insert DominanceToVector(d_qk=32, normalise=True) between V2D and SDPA on Q/K so SDPA operates on 32-dim Borda+LN rank embeddings instead of 496-dim ±1 dominance vectors. (2) attn_scale_init 0.4 -> 0.18 (= 1/sqrt(d_qk), the principled SDPA scale for unit-normalized 32-dim vectors). First attempt with init=0.4 saturated softmax (logits ~ 0.4*sqrt(32) ~ 2.26 too peaky) and lost 0.13 bpb at step 400. Param impact: negligible.
